description: CrowdSec Agent for Windows This release fixes a false positive in the bot detection feature for Brave Browser with shields enabled. ## Changes ## Improvements • add HasValidChallengeCookie() helper (#4648) @blotus ## Bug Fixes • lapi：return an empty slice instead of null when querying alerts (#4653) @blotus • challenge：tolerate strings instead of struct in FP payload (#4655) @blotus ## Geolite2 notice This product includes GeoLite2 data created by MaxMind, available from https://www.maxmind.com. ## Installation Take a look at the [installation instructions](https://doc.crowdsec.net/docs/getting_started/install_crowdsec).
